 In summary of the current state of knowledge of nutritional 
genomics with respect to cardiovascular disease, considerable 
research is being conducted globally. The identification of nu-
merous gene variants with associations to different aspects of 
cardiovascular health suggests that progress is being made in 
identifying susceptibility variants that can be modulated 
through judicious diet and lifestyle choices (Merched and 
Chan, 2013).
Inflammatory Disorders
Inflammation now is recognized as an underlying factor in 
chronic disorders, from heart disease to cancer to diabetes to 
obesity to more traditional inflammatory disorders such as ar-
thritis and the inflammatory bowel disorders. Inflammation is 
a normal and desirable response to insult by the body. Typically 
inflammation is an acute phase response; once the threat has
